user: May senior citizen discount po ba kayo?

user: Paano i-apply ang senior discount dito sa chat ordering?

user: Apat kaming kakain pero isa lang ang Senior Citizen, discounted ba lahat?

user: Pwede bang i-combine ang Senior discount sa 20% off promo niyo?
